description.value: Mackenzie Cafe is a multi-station campus food court located in the Academic Quadrangle at Simon Fraser University's Burnaby Mountain campus. It brings together several distinct food concepts under one roof, including Triple O's burgers, San Marzano's oven-fired pizza, a sushi bar, Bok Choy's made-to-order stir fry, C+B sandwiches, and fair trade coffee with fresh-baked goods. For a cyclist who has made the climb up Burnaby Mountain, it offers a broad range of made-to-order and grab-and-go options in a single stop.
